g.text: Illustrative model, not vendor data: effective throughput = min(B, M x S / k); B = 500 GB/s; k = 4 metadata ops per file (lookup, open, getattr, close);
crossover S* = k x B / M (20 MB, 2 MB, 200 KB). Data: data/ch21_small_file_throughput.csv
